zones.name: Ocean Drive & South Beach
zones.description: Iconic coastal boulevard lined with pastel Art Deco boutique hotels, swaying Florida palm trees, and wide golden sand beach.

zones.name: Escobar International Airport
zones.description: Crossing asphalt runways, passenger terminal concourse with jet bridges, ATC radar tower, and private aircraft hangars.

zones.name: Viceport Cargo Harbor
zones.description: Deep-water cargo container ship pier, rail gantry cranes, container stacks, chemical tank farm, and chop shop garage.

zones.name: Starfish Island
zones.description: Tommy Vercetti's sprawling luxury mansion estate with circular fountain driveway, wings, and backyard bayfront pool.

zones.name: Downtown Vice City
zones.description: Glass skyscraper towers with rooftop helipads, VCN transmission spire, and the Hyman Memorial Stadium at the northern tip.

zones.name: Little Haiti & Little Havana
zones.description: Vibrant Latin commercial blocks, taxi depots, storefronts, and alleyways connecting Downtown to the airport.

zones.name: Prawn Island & Movie Studios
zones.description: InterGlobal Movie Studios soundstages and vintage colonial mansions on the north bay causeway.

zones.name: Leaf Links Golf Club
zones.description: Manicured golf fairways, sand traps, water hazards, and the Leaf Links Clubhouse.

zones.name: Biscayne Bay Causeway Bridges
zones.description: Four causeway bridges connecting the West Mainland, Starfish Island, and East Beach Island over turquoise bay water.
